title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
source: canonical Binary Tree Level Order Traversal concept; description, examples, and tests re-authored
description: The input is the root node of a binary tree. Return the values level by level: one list per level, from the root downward, each list holding that level’s values left to right.
constraints: the tree stays balanced enough that recursion is safe

examples.explanation: Three levels, each listed left to right.
An empty tree has no levels.

hints: A queue naturally visits nodes level by level if whole levels are processed together.
Keep a list of the current level’s nodes; their children form the next level.
Loop: collect the values of the current level, gather the children into the next level, repeat until no nodes remain.
solution: Breadth-first sweep: hold the current level’s nodes in a list, emit their values, and gather their children into the next level. O(n) time, O(width) space.
failureHint: hidden tests include a single node and levels of very different widths
